project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Instrumental Cinematic Club Energy

arrangement.notes: Instrumental arrangement emphasizing cinematic mood with club energy dynamics; modern sample chopping techniques are used for texture and rhythm layering.

event_markers.label: Intro to Verse 1 Transition
event_markers.reason: Shift from introductory cinematic textures to established club groove

event_markers.label: Hook Entry
event_markers.reason: Bass intensifies to increase energy at hook section

event_markers.label: Bridge FX Build
event_markers.reason: Add tension using chopped and stuttered samples

event_markers.label: Final Hook Drum Peak
event_markers.reason: Maximize energy and club feel for final hook

track_roles.drums: rhythm foundation with sample chopping and slicing
track_roles.melody: lead elements using stutter and chop effects
track_roles.fx: atmospheric and dynamic effects using chopping and stuttering

sensei_drum.brief: Create dynamic drum patterns using modern sample slicing and chopping techniques that build club energy and support a cinematic mood.

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines with sliced sample layers that enhance groove and complement the cinematic instrumental arrangement.

harmony_generator.brief: Design harmonic textures employing sliced samples to maintain a cinematic atmosphere with a subtle underlying chord presence.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melodic lines using chopped and stuttered sample effects to add interest and cinematic flair without dominating instrumentation.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow ensuring smooth transitions, effective energy curve, and appropriate use of sample chopping techniques across lanes.

presetor.brief: Apply presets focusing on sample chopping and slicing to each channel to reinforce the cinematic and club energy tones.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement structure, section markers, and energy progression in line with West Coast Hip-Hop instrumental standards.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mixes emphasizing clarity of chopped samples and balances club energy with cinematic atmosphere in unprocessed audio.
